wreckCove.note: P7 wreck kit v2 (public/harbour/kit manifest wreck_kit). slots: rank 1..88 by peak market cap; kit = the wreck model; scale = its tier scale (multiply by the 0.8-1.15 log-peak-cap spread within a tier); sits = sand (y = ground) or water (y = sea level). headingRad = the kit +x (bow) along (sin h, 0, cos h): its +z front (epitaph board) faces h - pi/2. memorialArc: the top 20 standalone epitaph posts (wreck_cove_epitaph at 2.2x, rank order), so ranks 1-20 hide their own post. The bell, pennants and cove props are baked into island.glb.
